live.headline: AeroBlade: a threat actor with a catalogue entry but no public reports in this library
live.in_short: AeroBlade is listed in the MISP galaxy catalogue with no aliases and no named tools. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: AeroBlade is a threat actor listed in the MISP galaxy catalogue.
